params.val: an incoming non-damaging (status) move used against the holder has its accuracy set to exactly 50%, overriding its normal accuracy
the incoming move is not a status move, or the move's accuracy is not a plain number (e.g. an always-hit effect)

Showdown source (onModifyAccuracy) unconditionally overrides to 50 for any numeric-accuracy status move — no comparison against the move's original accuracy. Previous fail_if wording ("already 50% or lower") was an unverified guess not supported by source; the override can even raise accuracy for a rare sub-50% status move.
